  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-F70-EU-PR-01

Smooth dual-clutch gearbox and immediate response when pulling away

Proposal
1, implement. Drivetrain complaints (123 rows, 6.5 %, 73 usability) and transmission complaints (48 rows, 12 defects) describe a dead spot when pulling away at junctions and jerky DCT behaviour; the study scores acceleration at 8.21 vs 8.90.
Horizon
H1. Engine, hybrid and gearbox calibration.
Domain
Powertrain, Range & Charging
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

The car shall pull away without a perceptible delay or jerk, including when the throttle is pressed while still rolling, and the gearbox shall shift smoothly at low speed and when cold.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
EUDelay from throttle input to traction when rolling below 10 km/h<= 0.3 sVehicle measurementassumption
EUStudy acceleration (1-10)>= 8.8 (today 8.21, peer 8.90)Next EU customer study waveevidence
EUPull-away and gearbox complaint rows-50 % within 12 monthsCustomer feedbackassumption
